title: Waxwing
blurb: The waxwings are three species of passerine birds classified in the genus Bombycilla.
facts: Some of the wing feathers have red tips, the resemblance of which to sealing wax gives these birds their common name.
According to most authorities, this is the only genus placed in the family Bombycillidae, although sometimes the family is extended to include related taxa that are more usually...
There are three species: the Bohemian waxwing, the Japanese waxwing and the cedar waxwing.
